rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Vigile provides security scanning and trust scoring for MCP servers and agent skills. It detects tool poisoning, data exfiltration, prompt injection, and supply chain attacks across servers from npm, Smithery, and PyPI, plus agent skills from Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw. Each server and skill receives a 0-100 trust score, and the platform covers 54 detection rules across seven platforms.
